# Once a year, every foreign county of Britannia in the realm of a ruler under an Ascendancy modifier has a chance to take his culture:
# 1% a year, +5 with the first Ascendancy, +5 with the second, +6 with the Last Revenge (up to 17% a year).
eir_brit_conversion_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		eir_is_gael_ruler_trigger = yes
		is_ai = no
		OR = {
			has_character_modifier = eir_brit_ascendancy_1_modifier
			has_character_modifier = eir_brit_ascendancy_2_modifier
			has_character_modifier = eir_brit_ascendancy_3_modifier
		}
	}
	effect = {
		every_sub_realm_county = {
			limit = {
				empire = title:e_britannia
				eir_foreign_britain_county_trigger = yes
			}
			random = {
				chance = 1
				modifier = {
					add = 5
					root = { has_character_modifier = eir_brit_ascendancy_1_modifier }
				}
				modifier = {
					add = 5
					root = { has_character_modifier = eir_brit_ascendancy_2_modifier }
				}
				modifier = {
					add = 6
					root = { has_character_modifier = eir_brit_ascendancy_3_modifier }
				}
				eir_brit_convert_county_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
